title: Leveraging machine learning algorithms in dynamic modeling of urban expansion, surface heat islands, and carbon storage for sustainable environmental management in coastal ecosystems
key_result: Mean daytime LST rose from 27.72 C (1996) to 31.78 C (2021), the no-carbon-stock zone grew by 355.78% while very high carbon stock fell by 47.78%, and CA-ANN projects LST above 32 C on 22.51% of the area by 2041.

method_details.brightness_temperature: BT = K2 / ln(K1/L + 1) - 273.15 (K1, K2 from scene metadata)
method_details.lst_equation: LST = BT / (1 + (lambda * BT / rho) * ln(LSE)), rho = 1.438e-2 m K; LST = mean of bands 10 and 11
method_details.lst_outlier_filter: remove pixels above mean + 3 SD (about 0.1% of pixels per year)
method_details.carbon_formula: C = sum over classes of A_m * (C_above + C_below + C_soil + C_dead)
method_details.carbon_density_mg_per_ha_note: Divide Mg/km2 by 100 to get Mg/ha (e.g. Evergreen Forest above-ground 70.7 Mg/ha)

indices.NDBI: (SWIR - NIR)/(SWIR + NIR); TM SWIR=B5 NIR=B4; OLI SWIR=B6 NIR=B5
indices.NDVI: (NIR - R)/(NIR + R); TM NIR=B4 R=B3; OLI NIR=B5 R=B4
indices.NDWI: (Green - SWIR)/(Green + SWIR); TM Green=B2 SWIR=B5; OLI Green=B3 SWIR=B6 (Gao 1996)

regression.sampling: stratified random, proportional to LULC class area

method_details.cross_section: Profile Graph along lines A-B, C-D, E-F, G-H (text says three lines)

ca_ann.inputs: historical LST maps (dependent), spectral indices and DEM (independent)
ca_ann.sampling: 500 m x 500 m grid, 20% of cells, 5 points per cell, about 2000 points per period
